title: 第一章 ，幽灵列车，文明乘车
slug: 末日求生欧皇女配在线摇人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“本次里世界幽灵列车，途径欢乐消消乐、积木叠叠高、死亡大峡谷、最后终点站黄泉路。”

“基础任务：作为G444号乘客，平安做过一个站点，在任意一个车站站台下车。”

“进阶任务：作为G444号乘客，平安坐到终点站，在黄泉路车站站台下车。”

“终极任务：？？？（自行寻找）”

“鉴于居民都是第一次做任务，公开提供三条死亡规则提示，日后死亡规则只会有一条，剩余死亡规则需要居民自行寻找。”

“提示一：文明乘车。”

“提示二：看好自己的随身用品。”

“提示三：杜绝浪费。”

那道阴森诡谲的声音再次传入端木棠梨耳朵里，惊得她立即抬起头，看向自己周围情况。

真要世界末日了？那不是她的幻觉。

端木棠梨高考后，经小伙伴提醒，去奢侈品店抽奖，意外抽中特等奖——贵族学院录取通知书。

小伙伴得知后特别高兴，友情赠送各种各样大小姐的装备，带着自家弟弟cos她的小跟班，一起来到G102号列车上面前紫菱学校。

原本高高兴兴的旅途，被眼前的意外给打断，安全的G102号列车变成危机四伏的G444号幽灵列车。

之前端木棠梨刷抖音有听到那道阴森诡谲声音说，两个星球相撞，划分出安全区表世界，危险区里世界。

里世界还分为外区、内区、核心区，越往里走，越危险，污染越严重。

唯一好处是凌晨五点钟，有随机洗礼能帮助人类觉醒技能，甚至有天赋的人还能觉醒职业。

现在端木棠梨只能寄希望于凌晨五点洗礼，能提高众人活下去几率。

阴森诡谲的声音在脑海里消失后，黑雾里面的身影慢慢浮现在众人眼前。

顿时鸦雀无声，落针可闻。

不是黑雾出来的东西有多恐怖，恰恰相反，忽略他们呆滞的目光，透明的身体，就跟在场坐着的普通人别无二致，要是人身体里的灵魂体能看得到，说不定就是眼前的样子，给人更深的毛骨悚然感。

端木棠梨精神紧绷注视幽灵们一举一动，生怕它们会突然暴起，一口一个小妹妹。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"This time, the ghost train in the world passes through Happy Match, Stacked Blocks, the Grand Canyon of Death, and the final destination is Huangquan Road."

"Basic task: As a passenger of G444, make a stop safely and get off at any station platform."

"Advanced mission: As a passenger of G444, get to the terminal safely and get off at the Huangquan Road station platform."

"Ultimate mission: ??? (find it on your own)"

"Since this is the first time for residents to do the task, three death rule reminders are publicly provided. In the future, there will only be one death rule. Residents need to find the remaining death rules by themselves."

“Tip 1: Ride civilly.”

“Tip 2: Take care of your belongings.”

“Tip three: Stop wasting.”

The eerie voice reached Duanmu Tangli's ears again, and she was so startled that she immediately raised her head and looked at her surroundings.

Is the world really going to end?That wasn't her imagination.

After Duanmu Tangli took the college entrance examination, she was reminded by her friends that she went to a luxury store to draw a lottery, and unexpectedly won the special prize - an admission notice from a noble college.

The little friends were very happy after learning about it. They gave various kinds of equipment to the young lady, and took their younger brother to cosplay as her little follower, and went to Ziling School on the G102 train together.

The originally joyful journey was interrupted by an unexpected accident. The safe train G102 turned into the dangerous ghost train G444.

When Duanmu Tangli was browsing Douyin, she heard that eerie voice saying that two planets collided, dividing the world outside the safe zone and the world inside the dangerous zone.

The inner world is also divided into outer area, inner area, and core area. The further you go in, the more dangerous and serious the pollution becomes.

The only advantage is that at five o'clock in the morning, there is a random baptism that can help humans awaken their skills, and even talented people can awaken their professions.

Now Duanmu Tangli can only hope that the baptism at five o'clock in the morning can improve everyone's chance of survival.

After the eerie voice disappeared from his mind, the figure in the black mist slowly appeared in front of everyone.

There was a sudden silence, and you could hear a needle drop.

It's not that the things coming out of the black mist are scary, on the contrary, ignoring their dull eyes and transparent bodies, they are no different from the ordinary people sitting here. If the soul body in the human body can see it, it may be what they look like in front of them, giving people a deeper sense of creepiness.

Duanmu Tangli tensed up and watched every move of the ghosts, fearing that they would suddenly burst into flames and bite a little girl at a time.
